title: Dizon inspects Naia T1 ahead of Undas 2026 travel rush

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon inspected Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 1 on Friday as the country’s main gateway prepares to handle around 1.2 million travelers during the Undas travel period. “Nandito po tayo ngayon sa Naia Terminal 1 kasi nga direktiba ng Pangulo na siguraduhin natin na maging safe and comfortable at convenient ang biyahe ng mga kababayan natin,” Dizon told reporters. (We are here at Naia Terminal 1 because the President [Ferdinand Marcos Jr.] directed us to ensure safe, comfortable and convenient travel for our countrymen.)
